subject: VP/CTO availability bridge — demo window and fallback plan for CinderTech
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@cindertech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + request: 60m demo with VP/CTO availability

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week (via Lydia). We got a green light from the sponsoring program team to evaluate Redwood for a possible inference consolidation across our data platform. Our CTO, Maya Patel, and VP of Infrastructure, Daniel Cho, want a high-level demo that focuses on:

- predictable latency for mixed traffic
- routing/fallbacks across regions
- cost/levers for high throughput batched workloads

We'd like to find one 60-minute slot during the week of Nov 29–Dec 3. Ideally both Maya and Daniel can attend for the first 30 minutes for architecture/Q&A, then we can go deeper with our infra leads and SREs.

Are you able to run that session? If yes, can you propose 2–3 slots that align with PST morning (our side prefers mornings)?

Attaching our brief background and a one-pager on current throughput constraints.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Senior Platform PM, CinderTech
alex@cindertech.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments (2): CinderTech_background.pdf (pdf), throughput_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cindertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: 60m demo with VP/CTO availability

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. Happy to run this and align the session to the CTO/VP agenda you outlined.

Possible 60-minute windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Dec 2, 10:30–11:30
- Thu Dec 3, 08:30–09:30

Plan idea: 30 min architecture + exec Q&A (Maya/Daniel) + 30 min deep dive with infra/SRE. If Maya/Daniel can only make a portion, we will record the architecture portion and provide a short note with action items.

Marissa is looping in to confirm VP/CTO coverage and to run through our internal run-of-show. Marissa — can you take point on staffing the first 30 minutes and identify a backup if one of our execs is pulled?

I'll hold Tue Dec 1 09:00 tentatively and send a calendar invite after we confirm.

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: executive_brief_notes.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + request: 60m demo with VP/CTO availability

Priyom / Ben — quick internal note on coverage.

I can host the architecture + exec Q&A if Priyom is in a client meeting during that window. Ben — can you serve as backup executive presence if either Maya or Daniel has to drop last minute? Ben would cover vendor-level SLA and cost/commit questions.

Proposed internal run-of-show (we'll keep tight):
- 0–5m: intros (Priyom/Marissa/CinderTech sponsors)
- 5–35m: exec-focused architecture overview + targeted Q&A (Marissa lead)
- 35–60m: infra deep dive (Ben + solutions engs)

Fallbacks: if CTO or VP can only join for 15 minutes, we'll run the architecture in the first 20 minutes and prioritize the three listed executive questions (latency SLOs, routing/fallbacks, unit cost drivers).

Also flagged: ask for an attendee list from CinderTech and SRE contact info so we can prep relevant dashboards. I uploaded an initial MAP draft to the deal in HubSpot.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Related internal attachment: MAP_for_CinderTech_v1.pdf (internal)
